data.text:
IN PHOTOS: Department of Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon, together with Manila City Mayor Isko Moreno, will inspect the newly completed road and drainage improvement along the northbound lane of Taft Avenue from UN Avenue to Ayala Avenue.

The project includes the construction of larger drainage pipes measuring 1.5-meters in diameter, replacing the old 0.61-meter drainage. The upgrade will reduce flooding along Taft Avenue, particularly from TM Kalaw to Ayala Boulevard. 

📸: Norman Cruz
